global.criterion: Coherent rounded three-dimensional illustration with realistic materials, depth and contact shadows; not flat line art.
No readable or invented text, logos, numbers, watermarks, arrows or check marks.
No visible people, characters, faces or detached human body parts.
Relevant objects are readable, intact where required, sensibly proportioned and uncropped.

s101-overview.criterion: Field, accessible route and preparation bench are distinct.
Tractor is separated from the walking route.
No depicted casualty, spill or unsafe action.

s101-site.criterion: Burrow and sprinkler head are distinct obstacles.
Buried pipe and cable conduit visible below a soil cutaway.
Probe is resting and does not penetrate the ground.

s101-contact.criterion: Two sets of equipment, phone or radio, and access route identifiable.
Screens contain no text or numbers.

s101-tools.criterion: Sound spade has a secure continuous handle and intact blade.
Broken handle is isolated and unmistakably unusable.
Reagent is closed; no bare hand or handling action.

s101-weather.criterion: Usable shade, drinking water and sun hat are visible.
Insects remain at a separate bush away from the rest area.

s101-protection.criterion: Safety spectacles and sealed-rim splash goggles are separate and visibly different.
Boots, long clothing, hat and gloves are identifiable.

s101-compatibility.criterion: Fabric gloves visibly woven and chemical glove pair visibly non-porous with longer cuffs.
Closed reagent and information booklet are visible.
No chemical handling or implied compatibility verdict.

s101-checks.criterion: Five distinct preparation groups are visible without text.
Tool rests safely; no unsafe work depicted.

s101-lesson-route.criterion: Low perspective along path; no soil cutaway.
Sprinkler, burrow and separated tractor visible.

s101-lesson-gloves.criterion: Distinct compartmented storage composition, not flat workbench.
Glove materials and separate splash goggles are recognizable.
Reagent closed and no compatibility verdict.
